newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firms late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate steady, baht firms late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate remained stable in the 12.50-13.00 percent range in late sluggish trading on Wednesday as major banks resisted a lower rate trend on sustained baht fund demand from finance and brokerage firms, dealers said.
"Big banks do not have to make lower offers as they could lend to finance companies at better rates of 14-15 percent," said a foreign bank dealer.
The baht firmed to 25.390-25.395 to the dollar in late moderate activities from 25.398-25.404 in the morning but was slightly weaker than 25.388-25.392 late on Tuesday.

"The forex market is a bit more active than the money market where some dealers took time off to follow the no-confidence debate in parliament," another dealer said. The no-confidence debate against Prime Minister Banharn Silpa-archa began on Wednesday and is due to last three days.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium eased to 9.25-9.75 satangs per dollar from 9.50-10.50 in the morning and 10.00 late on Tuesday.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the baht/dollar midrate at 25.39 against 25.38 on Tuesday.
